   100	def get_connection(mode: str):
   101	    """
   102	    Obtiene una conexion mediante el adaptador canonico.
   103
   104	    diagnostic y validate exigen HRLectura antes de abrir.
   105	    migrate conserva un contrato separado y su guardrail explicito.
   106	    """
   107	    if mode in {"diagnostic", "validate"}:
   108	        readonly_factory = build_hrlectura_connection_factory(
   109	            config_loader=_load_readonly_profile,
   110	            connection_opener=_open_readonly_profile,
   111	        )
   112	        return readonly_factory()
   113
   114	    return get_edarsahub_pymssql_connection(
   115	        timeout=get_int_env(
   116	            "EDARSAHUB_SQL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS",
   117	            60,
   118	        ),
   119	        login_timeout=get_int_env(
   120	            "EDARSAHUB_SQL_LOGIN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS",
   121	            15,
   122	        ),
   123	        autocommit=False,

   127	def read_sql_file(script_path: Path) -> str:
   128	    if script_path.suffix.lower() != ".sql":
   129	        raise RuntimeError("Solo se permiten archivos .sql")
   130
   131	    if not script_path.exists():
   132	        raise RuntimeError(f"No existe el script: {script_path}")
   133
   134	    return script_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

   137	def validate_sql_safety(sql: str, mode: str) -> None:
   138	    sql_upper = sql.upper()
   139
   140	    for pattern in FORBIDDEN_PATTERNS:
   141	        if re.search(pattern, sql_upper, re.IGNORECASE):
   142	            raise RuntimeError(f"SQL bloqueado por patrón peligroso: {pattern}")
   143
   144	    if re.search(DANGEROUS_DELETE_PATTERN, sql_upper, re.IGNORECASE):
   145	        raise RuntimeError("SQL bloqueado: DELETE sin WHERE.")
   146
   147	    if mode in {"diagnostic", "validate"}:
   148	        blocked = [
   149	            r"\bCREATE\s+TABLE\b",
   150	            r"\bALTER\s+TABLE\b",
   151	            r"\bDROP\b",
   152	            r"\bINSERT\s+INTO\b",
   153	            r"\bUPDATE\b",
   154	            r"\bDELETE\s+FROM\b",
   155	            r"\bMERGE\b",
   156	        ]
   157	        for pattern in blocked:
   158	            if re.search(pattern, sql_upper, re.IGNORECASE):
   159	                raise RuntimeError(
   160	                    f"El modo {mode} no permite cambios de estructura o datos. Patrón detectado: {pattern}"
   161	                )
   162
   163	    if mode == "migrate":
   164	        allow = os.getenv("EDARSAHUB_ALLOW_MIGRATIONS", "").lower()
   165	        if allow != "true":
   166	            raise RuntimeError(
   167	                "Migración bloqueada. Define EDARSAHUB_ALLOW_MIGRATIONS=true para permitir ejecución."
   168	            )
   169
   170
   171	def split_sql_batches(sql: str) -> list[str]:
   172	    """
   173	    Divide scripts SQL Server por GO en línea independiente.
   174	    """
   175	    batches = re.split(r"^\s*GO\s*$", sql, flags=re.IGNORECASE | re.MULTILINE)
   176	    return [batch.strip() for batch in batches if batch.strip()]
   177
   178
   179	def execute_sql(sql: str, mode: str) -> dict:
   180	    if mode == "dry-run":
   181	        return {
   182	            "success": True,
   183	            "mode": mode,
   184	            "message": "Dry-run ejecutado. No se aplicaron cambios.",
   185	            "batches": len(split_sql_batches(sql)),
   186	            "results": [],
   187	        }
   188
   189	    batches = split_sql_batches(sql)
   190	    results = []
   191	    conn = None
   192	    cursor = None
   193
   194	    try:
   195	        conn = get_connection(mode)
   196
   197	        if mode in {"diagnostic", "validate"}:
   198	            validate_readonly_identity(conn)
   199
   200	        cursor = conn.cursor(as_dict=True)
   201
   202	        for index, batch in enumerate(batches, start=1):
   203	            cursor.execute(batch)
   204
   205	            if cursor.description:
   206	                columns = [col[0] for col in cursor.description]
   207	                rows = cursor.fetchall()
   208	                results.append(
   209	                    {
   210	                        "batch": index,
   211	                        "type": "resultset",
   212	                        "columns": columns,
   213	                        "row_count": len(rows),
   214	                        "rows_preview": rows[:20],
   215	                    }
   216	                )
   217	            else:
   218	                results.append(
   219	                    {
   220	                        "batch": index,
   221	                        "type": "command",
   222	                        "rowcount": cursor.rowcount,
   223	                    }
   224	                )
   225
   226	        if mode == "migrate":
   227	            conn.commit()
   228	        else:
   229	            conn.rollback()
   230
   231	        return {
   232	            "success": True,
   233	            "mode": mode,
   234	            "message": "Ejecucion completada.",
   235	            "batches": len(batches),
   236	            "results": results,
   237	        }
   238
   239	    except Exception as exc:
   240	        if conn is not None:
   241	            try:
   242	                conn.rollback()
   243	            except Exception:
   244	                pass
   245
   246	        raise RuntimeError(
   247	            "Error ejecutando SQL. Se hizo rollback. "
   248	            f"Detalle: {exc}"
   249	        ) from exc
   250
   251	    finally:
   252	        if cursor is not None:
   253	            try:
   254	                cursor.close()
   255	            except Exception:
   256	                pass
   257
   258	        if conn is not None:
   259	            try:
   260	                conn.close()
   261	            except Exception:
   262	                pass
   263
   264
   265	def write_report(script_path: Path, mode: str, sql: str, result: dict | None, error: str | None) -> Path:
   266	    REPORT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   267
   268	    timestamp = dt.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
   269	    report_path = REPORT_DIR / f"{timestamp}_{mode}_{script_path.stem}.md"
   270
   271	    try:
   272	        cfg = get_edarsahub_sql_config()
   273	    except RuntimeError:
   274	        server = "NO_DEFINIDO"
   275	        database = "NO_DEFINIDO"
   276	    else:
   277	        server = cfg.host
   278	        database = cfg.database
   279
   280	    content = []
   281	    content.append(f"# EDARSAHUB SQL Runner Report\n")
   282	    content.append(f"- Fecha: {dt.datetime.now().isoformat()}")
   283	    content.append(f"- Modo: `{mode}`")
   284	    content.append(f"- Servidor: `{server}`")
   285	    content.append(f"- Base de datos: `{database}`")
   286	    content.append(f"- Script: `{script_path}`")
   287	    content.append("")
   288
   289	    if error:
   290	        content.append("## Resultado")
   291	        content.append("ERROR")
   292	        content.append("")
   293	        content.append("## Detalle")
   294	        content.append(f"```text\n{error}\n```")
   295	    else:
   296	        content.append("## Resultado")
   297	        content.append("OK")
   298	        content.append("")
   299	        content.append("## Resumen")
   300	        if result:
   301	            content.append(f"- Batches ejecutados: {result.get('batches', 0)}")
   302	            content.append(f"- Mensaje: {result.get('message', '')}")
   303	            content.append("")
   304
   305	            for r in result.get("results", []):
   306	                content.append(f"### Batch {r.get('batch')}")
   307	                if r.get("type") == "resultset":
   308	                    content.append(f"- Tipo: SELECT")
   309	                    content.append(f"- Columnas: {', '.join(r.get('columns', []))}")
   310	                    content.append(f"- Filas: {r.get('row_count', 0)}")
   311	                    if r.get("rows_preview"):
   312	                        content.append("- Preview (primeras 20 filas):")
   313	                        content.append("```")
   314	                        for row in r.get("rows_preview", [])[:10]:
   315	                            content.append(f"  {row}")
   316	                        content.append("```")
   317	                else:
   318	                    content.append(f"- Tipo: Comando")
   319	                    content.append(f"- Filas afectadas: {r.get('rowcount', 0)}")
   320	                content.append("")
   321
   322	    content.append("")
   323	    content.append("## SQL ejecutado / revisado")
   324	    content.append("```sql")
   325	    content.append(sql[:20000])
   326	    content.append("```")
   327
   328	    report_path.write_text("\n".join(content), encoding="utf-8")
   329	    return report_path
   330
   331
   332	def main() -> int:
   333	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
   334	        description=(
   335	            "EDARSAHUB SQL Runner "
   336	            "(canonical connection factory)"
   337	        )
   338	    )
   339	    parser.add_argument("--mode", required=True, choices=sorted(ALLOWED_MODES))
   340	    parser.add_argument("--script", required=True)
   341
   342	    args = parser.parse_args()
   343
   344	    mode = args.mode
   345	    script_path = Path(args.script).resolve()
   346
   347	    result = None
   348	    error = None
   349	    sql = ""
   350
   351	    try:
   352	        sql = read_sql_file(script_path)
   353	        validate_sql_safety(sql, mode)
   354	        result = execute_sql(sql, mode)
   355
   356	    except Exception as exc:
   357	        error = str(exc)
   358
   359	    report_path = write_report(script_path, mode, sql, result, error)
   360
   361	    if error:
   362	        print(f"ERROR: {error}")
   363	        print(f"Reporte generado: {report_path}")
   364	        return 1
   365
   366	    print("Ejecución completada correctamente.")
   367	    print(f"Reporte generado: {report_path}")
   368
   369	    # Imprimir resumen de resultados
   370	    if result:
   371	        for r in result.get("results", []):
   372	            if r.get("type") == "resultset":
   373	                print(f"  Batch {r.get('batch')}: {r.get('row_count')} filas")
   374
   375	    return 0
   376
   377
   378	if __name__ == "__main__":
   379	    sys.exit(main())

     5	@dataclass(frozen=True)
     6	class EdarsaHubSQLConfig:
     7	    host: str
     8	    port: int
     9	    database: str
    10	    user: str
    11	    password: str
    12	    profile: str = "default"

    15	_PROFILE_PREFIXES = {
    16	    "default": "EDARSAHUB_SQL",
    17	}
    18
    19
    20	def _required(name: str) -> str:
    21	    value = os.getenv(name)
    22	    if not value:
    23	        raise RuntimeError(f"Variable obligatoria no configurada: {name}")
    24	    return value
    25
    26
    27	def get_edarsahub_sql_config(profile: str = "default") -> EdarsaHubSQLConfig:
    28	    """
    29	    Config canónica EDARSAHUB SQL.
    30
    31	    Perfil permitido:
    32	    - default: configuracion canonica EDARSAHUB_SQL_*
    33
    34	    Los perfiles alternativos estan prohibidos.
    35	    """
    36	    normalized = (profile or "default").lower()
    37	    prefix = _PROFILE_PREFIXES.get(normalized)
    38	    if not prefix:
    39	        raise ValueError(f"Perfil EDARSAHUB SQL no soportado: {profile}")
    40
    41	    return EdarsaHubSQLConfig(
    42	        host=_required(f"{prefix}_HOST"),
    43	        port=int(os.getenv(f"{prefix}_PORT", "1433")),
    44	        database=_required(f"{prefix}_DATABASE"),
    45	        user=_required(f"{prefix}_USER"),
    46	        password=_required(f"{prefix}_PASSWORD"),
    47	        profile=normalized,
    48	    )

     1	from core.config.edarsahub_config import get_edarsahub_sql_config

     3	ODBC_DRIVER_NAME = "ODBC Driver 17 for SQL Server"
     4
     5
     6	def _connect_edarsahub_pymssql(
     7	    cfg,
     8	    *,
     9	    timeout: int = 30,
    10	    login_timeout: int = 10,
    11	    autocommit: bool = False,
    12	    tds_version: str | None = None,
    13	):
    14	    import pymssql
    15
    16	    connect_kwargs = {
    17	        "server": cfg.host,
    18	        "port": cfg.port,
    19	        "user": cfg.user,
    20	        "password": cfg.password,
    21	        "database": cfg.database,
    22	        "login_timeout": login_timeout,
    23	        "timeout": timeout,
    24	        "autocommit": autocommit,
    25	    }
    26
    27	    if tds_version is not None:
    28	        connect_kwargs["tds_version"] = tds_version
    29
    30	    return pymssql.connect(**connect_kwargs)
    31
    32
    33	def get_edarsahub_connection(profile: str = "default"):
    34	    """
    35	    Abre una conexion canonica a EDARSAHUB.
    36
    37	    Solo usa pymssql como fallback cuando pyodbc no puede importarse
    38	    o cuando el driver ODBC requerido no esta instalado.
    39
    40	    Los errores reales de conexion pyodbc se propagan sin fallback.
    41	    """
    42	    cfg = get_edarsahub_sql_config(profile)
    43
    44	    try:
    45	        import pyodbc
    46	    except ImportError:
    47	        return _connect_edarsahub_pymssql(
    48	            cfg,
    49	            tds_version="7.0",
    50	        )
    51
    52	    installed_drivers = set(pyodbc.drivers())
    53
    54	    if ODBC_DRIVER_NAME not in installed_drivers:
    55	        return _connect_edarsahub_pymssql(
    56	            cfg,
    57	            tds_version="7.0",
    58	        )
    59
    60	    return pyodbc.connect(
    61	        f"DRIVER={{{ODBC_DRIVER_NAME}}};"
    62	        f"SERVER={cfg.host},{cfg.port};"
    63	        f"DATABASE={cfg.database};"
    64	        f"UID={cfg.user};"
    65	        f"PWD={cfg.password};"
    66	        "TrustServerCertificate=yes;Encrypt=no;"
    67	    )
    68
    69
    70	def get_edarsahub_pymssql_connection(
    71	    timeout: int = 30,
    72	    login_timeout: int = 10,
    73	    autocommit: bool = False,
    74	):
    75	    """
    76	    Conexion EDARSAHUB centralizada via pymssql.
    77
    78	    Se conserva para modulos legacy que usan cursor(as_dict=True).
    79	    """
    80	    cfg = get_edarsahub_sql_config()
    81
    82	    return _connect_edarsahub_pymssql(
    83	        cfg,
    84	        timeout=timeout,
    85	        login_timeout=login_timeout,
    86	        autocommit=autocommit,
    87	    )
    88
    89	def get_external_sql_connection(config: dict):
    90	    """
    91	    Conexión centralizada a servidores externos.
    92	    No lee secretos de variables.
    93	    No imprime secretos.
    94	    """
    95	    if not config:
    96	        raise ValueError("Config externa requerida")
    97
    98	    host = config.get("host") or config.get("server") or config.get("servidor")
    99	    port = int(config.get("port") or config.get("puerto") or 1433)
   100	    database = config.get("database_name") or config.get("database") or config.get("base_datos") or config.get("bd")
   101	    username = config.get("username") or config.get("usuario") or config.get("user")
   102	    password = config.get("password_decrypted") or config.get("password") or config.get("pwd")
   103
   104	    if not host or not database or not username or not password:
   105	        raise ValueError("Config externa incompleta: host/database/username/password requeridos")
   106
   107	    try:
   108	        import pymssql
   109	        return pymssql.connect(
   110	            server=host,
   111	            port=port,
   112	            user=username,
   113	            password=password,
   114	            database=database,
   115	            login_timeout=10,
   116	            timeout=30,
   117	            tds_version="7.0",
   118	        )
   119	    except Exception:
   120	        import pyodbc
   121	        return pyodbc.connect(
   122	            "DRIVER={ODBC Driver 17 for SQL Server};"
   123	            f"SERVER={host},{port};"
   124	            f"DATABASE={database};"
   125	            f"UID={username};"
   126	            f"PWD={password};"
   127	            "TrustServerCertificate=yes;Encrypt=no;"
   128	        )

===== MIGRACION 016 COMPLETA =====
     1	/*
     2	EDARSAHUB V1.0
     3	Migracion: Scheduler_DistributedLocks
     4	Fecha: 2026-07-12
     5
     6	Objetivo:
     7	- Sustituir scheduler_locks de MongoDB.
     8	- Proporcionar exclusion mutua entre procesos y workers.
     9	- Soportar expiracion, heartbeat, liberacion por propietario
    10	  y liberacion administrativa.
    11	- No modificar las tablas existentes del scheduler.
    12
    13	Esta migracion no migra datos porque el lock Mongo actual

   429	    ic.is_included_column AS IsIncludedColumn

\n  // Desarrollo local\n  if (hostname === 'localhost' || hostname === '127.0.0.1') {\n    return true;\n  }\n  \n  return false;\n}\n\n/**\n * Obtiene información del ambiente actual\n * @returns {Object} Información del ambiente\n */\nexport function getEnvironmentInfo() {\n  const hostname = window.location.hostname;\n  const isPreview = isPreviewMode();\n  \n  let environment = * EDARSA HUB - Utilidades de Caché para Modo Preview\n * ===================================================\n * P0-CACHE-PREVIEW: Limpieza automática de caché en modo preview\n * \n * En modo preview, cada ingreso al sistema debe arrancar con caché limpia\n * para evitar estados corruptos de filtros, unidades, servidores, etc.\n * \n * NO AFECTA PRODUCCIÓN - Solo actúa en ambientes preview/staging\n */\n\n// =============================================================================\n// DETECCIÓN DE MODO PREVIEW\n// =============================================================================\n\n/**\n * Detecta si la aplicación está corriendo en modo preview/staging/desarrollo\n * \n * Criterios:\n * 1. URL contiene 'preview.emergentagent.com'\n * 2. URL contiene 'staging'\n * 3. Variable REACT_APP_PREVIEW_MODE='true'\n * 4. hostname es localhost (desarrollo local)\n * \n * @returns {boolean} true si está en modo preview\n */\nexport function isPreviewMode() {\n  // Verificar variable de entorno explícita\n  if (process.env.REACT_APP_PREVIEW_MODE === 'true') {\n    return true;\n  }\n  \n  // Verificar URL de preview de Emergent\n  const hostname = window.location.hostname;\n  if (hostname.includes('preview.emergentagent.com')) {\n    return true;\n  }\n  \n  // Verificar staging\n  if (hostname.includes('staging')) {\n    return true;\n  }\n  \n  // Desarrollo local\n  if (hostname === 'localhost' || hostname === '127.0.0.1') {\n    return true;\n  }\n  \n  return false;\n}\n\n/**\n * Obtiene información del ambiente actual\n * @returns {Object} Información del ambiente\n */\nexport function getEnvironmentInfo() {\n  const hostname = window.location.hostname;\n  const isPreview = isPreviewMode();\n  \n  let environment = 'production';\n  if (hostname.includes('preview.emergentagent.com')) {\n    environment = 'preview';\n  } else if (hostname.includes('staging')) {\n    environment = 'staging';\n  } else if (hostname === 'localhost' || hostname === '127.0.0.1') {\n    environment = 'development';\n  }\n  \n  return {\n    environment,\n    isPreview,\n    hostname,\n    timestamp: new Date().toISOString()\n  };\n}\n\n\n// =============================================================================\n// LLAVES DE CACHÉ A LIMPIAR\n// =============================================================================\n\nconst EDARSA_CACHE_KEYS = [\n  // Auth y Token\n  'edarsa_memory_token',\n  'auth_token',\n  'token',\n  'user',\n  'currentUser',\n  \n  // Selecciones\n  'selectedServer',\n  'selectedUnidadNegocio',\n  'selectedEmpresa',\n  'unidad_negocio_id',\n  'empresa_id',\n  \n  // Catálogos\n  'servers',\n  'servidores',\n  'unidades',\n  'unidades_negocio',\n  'empresas',\n  \n  // Dashboard y Módulos\n  'dashboard',\n  'dashboard_cache',\n  'comercial',\n  'comercial_cache',\n  'finanzas',\n  'finanzas_cache',\n  'operaciones',\n  'operaciones_cache',\n  'catalogo',\n  'catalogo_cache',\n  'compras',\n  'compras_cache',\n  \n  // RBAC y Permisos\n  'rbac',\n  'permisos',\n  'permissions',\n  'allowed_servers',\n  'allowed_empresas',\n  \n  // Filtros\n  'filtros',\n  'filters',\n  'dateRange',\n  'fechaInicio',\n  'fechaFin',\n  \n  // KPIs\n  'kpis_cache',\n  'ventas_cache',\n  'resumen_cache',\n  \n  // Otros\n  'edarsa_',\n  'edarsahub_',\n];\n\n// Marcador de sesión para evitar limpieza repetida\nconst CACHE_RESET_MARKER = 'edarsa_preview_cache_reset_done';\nconst BUILD_VERSION = process.env.REACT_APP_VERSION || Date.now().toString();\n\n\n// =============================================================================\n// FUNCIONES DE LIMPIEZA\n// =============================================================================\n\n/**\n * Limpia localStorage de llaves relacionadas con EDARSAHUB\n * @returns {number} Número de llaves limpiadas\n */\nfunction clearLocalStorage() {\n  let count = 0;\n  const keysToRemove = [];\n  \n  for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {\n    const key = localStorage.key(i);\n    if (key && shouldClearKey(key)) {\n      keysToRemove.push(key);\n    }\n  }\n  \n  keysToRemove.forEach(key => {\n    localStorage.removeItem(key);\n    count++;\n  });\n  \n  return count;\n}\n\n/**\n * Limpia sessionStorage de llaves relacionadas con EDARSAHUB\n * @returns {number} Número de llaves limpiadas\n */\nfunction clearSessionStorage() {\n  let count = 0;\n  const keysToRemove = [];\n  \n  for (let i = 0; i < sessionStorage.length; i++) {\n    const key = sessionStorage.key(i);\n    // No limpiar el marcador de reset ni el token activo\n    if (key && shouldClearKey(key) && key !== CACHE_RESET_MARKER) {\n      keysToRemove.push(key);\n    }\n  }\n  \n  keysToRemove.forEach(key => {\n    sessionStorage.removeItem(key);\n    count++;\n  });\n  \n  return count;\n}\n\n/**\n * Determina si una llave debe ser limpiada\n * @param {string} key - Nombre de la llave\n * @returns {boolean}\n */\nfunction shouldClearKey(key) {\n  const lowerKey = key.toLowerCase();\n  \n  // Verificar prefijos conocidos\n  if (lowerKey.startsWith('edarsa')) return true;\n  if (lowerKey.startsWith('edarsahub')) return true;\n  \n  // Verificar llaves específicas\n  for (const cacheKey of EDARSA_CACHE_KEYS) {\n    if (lowerKey === cacheKey.toLowerCase()) return true;\n    if (lowerKey.includes(cacheKey.toLowerCase())) return true;\n  }\n  \n  return false;\n}\n\n/**\n * Limpia Cache API del navegador (si existe)\n * @returns {Promise<number>} Número de caches limpiados\n */\nasync function clearBrowserCaches() {\n  if (!('caches' in window)) {\n    return 0;\n  }\n  \n  let count = 0;\n  try {\n    const cacheNames = await caches.keys();\n    for (const name of cacheNames) {\n      // Solo limpiar caches relacionados con EDARSAHUB\n      if (name.includes('edarsa') || name.includes('edarsahub') || name.includes('workbox')) {\n        await caches.delete(name);\n        count++;\n      }\n    }\n  } catch (e) {\n    console.warn('[PREVIEW_CACHE_RESET] Error limpiando browser caches:', e);\n  }\n  \n  return count;\n}\n\n/**\n * Limpia React Query cache (si está disponible globalmente)\n * @param {Object} queryClient - Instancia de QueryClient de React Query\n * @returns {boolean}\n */\nexport function clearReactQueryCache(queryClient) {\n  if (!queryClient) return false;\n  \n  try {\n    // Limpiar todas las queries\n    queryClient.clear();\n    \n    // Invalidar queries específicas si están en caché\n    const queryKeysToInvalidate = [\n      ['servers'],\n      ['servidores'],\n      ['unidades'],\n      ['unidades-negocio'],\n      ['empresas'],\n      ['comercial'],\n      ['dashboard'],\n      ['finanzas'],\n      ['operaciones'],\n      ['catalogo-sql'],\n      ['auth', 'me'],\n      ['rbac'],\n    ];\n    \n    queryKeysToInvalidate.forEach(key => {\n      try {\n        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: key });\n      } catch (e) {\n        // Ignorar si la query no existe\n      }\n    });\n    \n    console.log('[PREVIEW_CACHE_RESET] React Query cache cleared');\n    return true;\n  } catch (e) {\n    console.warn('[PREVIEW_CACHE_RESET] Error clearing React Query cache:', e);\n    return false;\n  }\n}\n\n\n// =============================================================================\n// FUNCIÓN PRINCIPAL DE LIMPIEZA\n// =============================================================================\n\n/**\n * Ejecuta limpieza completa de caché frontend en modo preview.\n * Solo ejecuta una vez por sesión (a menos que QueryClient de React Query (opcional)\n * @returns {Object} Resultado de la limpieza\n */\nexport async function clearPreviewFrontendCache(options = {}) {\n  const { force = false, queryClient = null } = options;\n  \n  // Solo ejecutar en modo preview\n  if (!isPreviewMode()) {\n    return {\n      executed: false,\n      reason: 'Not in preview mode',\n      environment: getEnvironmentInfo()\n    };\n  }\n  \n  // Verificar si ya se hizo la limpieza en esta sesión\n  const lastReset = sessionStorage.getItem(CACHE_RESET_MARKER);\n  if (!force && lastReset === BUILD_VERSION) {\n    return {\n executed: true,\n    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n    environment: getEnvironmentInfo(),\n    cleared: {\n      localStorage: 0,\n      sessionStorage: 0,\n      browserCaches: 0,\n      reactQuery: false\n    }\n  };\n  \n  try {\n    // 1. Limpiar localStorage\n    result.cleared.localStorage = clearLocalStorage();\n    console.log(`[PREVIEW_CACHE_RESET] localStorage cleared: ${result.cleared.localStorage} keys`);\n    \n    // 2. Limpiar sessionStorage (excepto marcador)\n    result.cleared.sessionStorage = clearSessionStorage();\n    console.log(`[PREVIEW_CACHE_RESET] sessionStorage cleared: ${result.cleared.sessionStorage} keys`);\n    \n    // 3. Limpiar Browser Caches\n    result.cleared.browserCaches = await clearBrowserCaches();\n    console.log(`[PREVIEW_CACHE_RESET] Browser caches cleared: ${result.cleared.browserCaches}`);\n    \n    // 4. Limpiar React Query (si se proporciona)\n    if (queryClient) {\n      result.cleared.reactQuery = clearReactQueryCache(queryClient);\n    }\n    \n    // 5. Marcar que ya se hizo la limpieza\n    sessionStorage.setItem(CACHE_RESET_MARKER, BUILD_VERSION);\n    \n    console.log('[PREVIEW_CACHE_RESET] Cache cleanup completed', result);\n    \n  } catch (e) {\n    console.error('[PREVIEW_CACHE_RESET] Error during cleanup:', e);\n    result.error = e.message;\n  }\n  \n  return result;\n}\n\n\n/**\n * Limpieza de caché al hacer logout (siempre ejecuta en preview)\n */\nexport function clearCacheOnLogout() {\n  if (!isPreviewMode()) return;\n  \n  console.log('[PREVIEW_CACHE_RESET] Clearing cache on logout...');\n  \n  // Limpiar todo excepto el marcador\n  clearLocalStorage();\n  clearSessionStorage();\n  \n  // Remover marcador para que se limpie de nuevo al próximo login\n  sessionStorage.removeItem(CACHE_RESET_MARKER);\n}\n\n\n/**\n * Llamar al backend para limpiar cachés del servidor (solo admin)\n * \n * @param {Object} api - Instancia de axios configurada\n * @returns {Promise<Object>} Resultado de la limpieza del backend\n */\nexport async function clearPreviewBackendCache(api) {\n  if (!isPreviewMode()) {\n    return { executed: false, reason: 'Not in preview mode' };\n  }\n  \n  try {\n    const response = await
